button_scenes.title: Configure regular scenes
button_scenes.description: Four scenes are suggested. Only rows with a selected Home Assistant scene are stored; the remaining rows are ignored. At least one regular scene is required. Separate Toggle mode supports KNX scene numbers 1–64. In Neutral Scene mode, scene number 1 is reserved for neutral and regular scenes use 2–64.

button_neutral.title: Configure neutral scene
button_neutral.description: In Neutral Scene mode, KNX scene number 1 is assigned automatically. The first activation switches to neutral; another activation restores the last regular scene.

error.duplicate_knx_scene_numbers: KNX scene numbers must be unique within one scene button.
error.duplicate_group_addresses: Scene selection and toggle group addresses must be different.
error.conflicting_group_address_roles: A group address cannot be used for scene selection on one scene button and as a toggle address on another.
error.invalid_configuration: The scene button configuration is invalid.
